title: Price alerts that stay lit until acknowledged
prompt: In src/App.svelte, show a live board of the quotes from src/feed.ts (subscribe() calls onQuote with { symbol, last, volume }), with a row for each symbol in SYMBOLS and the columns Symbol and Last. src/levels.ts has an alert level above and below each symbol's price. When a symbol's last price reaches its above level or falls to its below level, highlight its row, and keep it highlighted even if the price comes back, until someone acknowledges it: by pressing A on the row, or with an "Acknowledge all" button.
